mostWorthwhile.text: Making the water filter was the most worthwhile moment: the description explained how the sand and charcoal layers fit inside the pipe.

leastWorthwhile.text: Filling and then covering the jar were predictable steps, though they completed the storage sequence.

surprise.text: The reminder that filtered water can still contain harmful microbes clarified why boiling was necessary.

arbitrary.text: No action I chose felt arbitrary; each had a clear connection to filtering, storage or drainage.

continue.text: I would probably continue for another chapter: the filter assembly and the separation of drinking and washing water made the practical sequence interesting.
